In the last RAN#106 plenary, a new work item on solutions for Ambient-IoT (Internet of Things) in NR was approved [1]. Ambient-IoT is a new 3GPP IoT technology that relies on ultra-low complexity devices with ultra-low power consumption for very-low-end IoT applications. In the last RAN2#129bis [2] the following agreements were made in regards the A-IoT paging agenda-item: RAN2#129bis In alignment with the agreements made in the last RAN2 meeting, our contribution further explores these functionalities and discuss potential areas for improvement.

Dedicated resource configuration is only given to the UE reader via dedicated signalling. Mechanisms for shared resource pool amongst readers are not considered in this release. The UE may perform the AIoT procedure on AIoT interface between the reader and the device only if the resource configuration is valid in the cell under network control. FFS how valid resource is determined – we will consider temporary out of connection scenarios. FFS on resource validity across multiple cells. The AIoT radio resource can be (re)configured during RRC reconfiguration (including during HO procedure, after re-establishment, etc).
